item.title: QuotaCell: Let your team spend without handing over the treasury (1 posts)
item.description: QuotaCell progress: Owner revocation and treasury recovery now tested on CKB In my previous update, I shared how QuotaCell enforces shared spending limits through CKB scripts. This week, I focused on another important question: Can a treasury owner revoke delegated access and recover the protected funds without relying on the delegates? I’ve now tested the owner-control lifecycle using real signed transactions on a fresh isolated CKB node, without modifying the existing policy. The results: Revocation: An owner-signed transaction revoked a delegate’s authority and committed successfully. Enforcement: A newly signed payment using the updated policy state reached the node and was rejected...

item.title: [DIS] Rypto — CKB Content & Advocacy Campaign (1 posts)
One Fiber LSP, 11,496 channels (2 posts)
item.description: You mentioned that a single payment took 3.8–4.8 seconds with 350 channels. Have you measured payment time with the smallest possible setup? Using WebSocket subscriptions on the client to receive signing requests could significantly reduce per-payment latency. In my own tests with a minimal setup, I’m seeing around 500 ms per payment, although that’s under fairly ideal conditions. Also, I think we might need to control the test variables a bit more carefully, especially CPU configuration (4 vs 8 cores) and whether store_sync_writes is enabled. Otherwise, it’s hard to isolate the actual bottleneck.

item.title: [DIS] Kirea Finance: Native RWA Lending Infrastructure for CKB |【DIS】Kirea Finance：面向 CKB 的原生 RWA 借贷基础设施 (1 posts)
item.description: Based on the Metaforo tally at close, the outcome is Not Passed. Approval is 21.08%/51% with total voting weight 155,002,245/13,982,642 CKB. Post-close verification has been completed using CKB DAO Watchdog, together with a manual sanity check. The verification cross-checks Metaforo-recorded voting weights against on-chain Nervos DAO deposit weights. In this run, all entries match. The Kirea Finance proposal is confirmed as NOT PASSED. Verification logs: ckb-dao-watchdog/Verification Logs - Kirea at main · kydchen/ckb-dao-watchdog · GitHub
